strings.name: Bjarne Stroustrup
strings.summary: Bjarne Stroustrup designed and first implemented C++ at Bell Labs, bringing classes, abstraction and generic programming to high-performance systems. Through books, standardization and teaching, he explored the relationship between efficiency, resource management and expressive programs. His work spans industrial laboratories, universities and financial technology, supporting programming that combines low-level control with ways to organize complex software.

strings.influence.rationale: Designed C++, advancing systems programming and object-oriented techniques in industrial software, finance and scientific computing.

strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Aarhus University master's (1975); University of Cambridge computer-science PhD (1979)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: C++ language
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Designed and implemented C++, combining efficient systems programming with data abstraction.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Books and standards
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Authored The C++ Programming Language and contributed to language standards and programming practice.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Modern C++ at CERN
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Spoke to scientific-software developers about safer, simpler and more efficient programming.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Columbia professorship
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Became a full-time professor at Columbia after a long association as a visiting professor.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Draper Prize
strings.timeline.event-3.text: The US National Academy of Engineering honored his conception and development of C++.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Computer History Museum fellow
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Recognized for inventing C++ and contributions to programming.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: First ISO C++ standard
strings.timeline.event-5.text: The first ISO C++ standard established a common specification across implementations.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Book and commercial release
strings.timeline.event-6.text: The C++ Programming Language appeared alongside the language's first commercial release.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: PhD and Bell Labs
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Completed his Cambridge doctorate, joined Bell Labs and began work that developed into C++.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Aarhus master's degree
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Earned a master's in mathematics and computer science before studying distributed systems at Cambridge.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Aarhus
